model.name: Current-task has ONE definition site — pinRole reads the designation resolver, not a parallel guess (Tron-caught second-source)
model.description: Current-task selection has EXACTLY ONE definition site. Tron set a task current, but a different task RENDERS current, because there are TWO definitions of 'current' in one system: (A) the DESIGNATION resolver getThreeSlots (CurrentSprint.ts:270) honors the owner's currentTaskUuid EXPLICIT-WINS-WHILE-VALID (make-current, R40.49) — read by pin/scoreboard; (B) a rogue parallel HEURISTIC derivedCurrentTaskUuid (server.ts:1388) that IGNORES the designation, loops all Tasks, keeps only deriveStatusEnum=='In Progress', picks max lastAdvancedAt — attachTaskPinRole (:1399) tags pinRole='current' off B and the action-bar rides B. So what Tron SETS != what RENDERS, and a QA-Review task can NEVER be current (In-Progress-only filter). FIX AT THE ROOT (one resolver, NOT a hardcode — a39efc32 appears nowhere in src): DELETE derivedCurrentTaskUuid; pinRole reads slots.current from the SAME compute-once getThreeSlots output as pin/scoreboard/tree; eligibility {Planned,In-Progress,QA-Review} everywhere; honest-absence on ambiguity. The gate must assert the HAZARD (a Task-selection loop returning a uuid by status/timestamp) not an actor-blocklist, and must be proven RED on TODAY's live defect before the fix.

model.metaFinding: check:pin-single-source (scripts/check-pin-single-source.ts:15-18) is a 2-regex ACTOR BLOCKLIST (filter(status==='Active') + sprintName->number.find, both SPRINT-level) and shipped GREEN over this TASK-level second source = it asserts the WRONG property. A blocklist of code SHAPES can never prove a single-source invariant (the next divergence is always a new shape). It is REPLACED by the hazard-based gate (AC-gate-asserts-hazard-not-actors). Same failure class as R40.55's boot hand-list + the marker-name-vs-scope gate. [[scan-the-hazard-not-the-actors]]

'0 such selections outside the accessor' proves single-source in ONE number (same shape as '0 raw insertAdjacentHTML outside the primitive'). REPLACES the retired check-pin-single-source 2-regex ACTOR BLOCKLIST (see metaFinding).

model.computeOnceServerHole: ★ HOLE FOUND 2026-08-24 (architect 954dbf994): AC-compute-once-pass-down NAMED the 'slotsFrom twice with different inputs = still two sources' subtlety but NEVER ENFORCED it on the SERVER render path. #3 (Tron defect #5 live on v0.8.126): /api/trace/children?mode=trace calls slotsFrom with DIFFERENT/missing designation inputs, computing a slots that DISAGREES with the pin's slots.current = the compute-once hole, server-side. The drawer path (server.ts:2725) reads slots.current correctly; the /trace endpoint does not. FIX (#3 immediate): the endpoint reads the SAME per-request slots the pin uses (compute-once-pass-down), never its own slotsFrom call. This is the compute-once invariant landing on #3; the DURABLE closure is R37.24 (extended to scan the server tree). R40.56's compute-once AC was client-render-scoped in practice; R37.24 generalizes it to client-OR-server.
